ja174:1.1: I have given you plenty of water,
ja174:1.2: When you were scorched by heat, and were thirsty.
ja174:1.3: Now, having drunk, you are chattering away,
ja174:1.4: It’s best to be detached from bad people.
ja174:2.1: Whoever heard or saw what is known as a virtuous monkey?
ja174:2.3: Now I have defecated on you,
